name: Echoes of the Dam
description: Restore power to the Mojave by reactivating Hoover Dam’s turbines.
objectives: Retrieve missing turbine parts from Helios One

endings.description: You hand control of the Dam to Mojave settlers.
You give control to a militarized faction.
endings.consequence: Faction gains dominance, settlers are oppressed.

endings.description: You sabotage the turbines, leaving the Dam offline.
endings.consequence: No one controls the power, chaos spreads across the Mojave.

name: The Vault Experiment
description: Investigate Mojave Vaults to uncover the truth about Vault-Tec’s experiments.

endings.description: You expose Vault-Tec’s crimes to the Mojave.
You sell the data to a Mojave faction.

endings.consequence: No one learns the truth, history erased.

name: The Nuclear Trail
description: Track down missing nuclear prototypes scattered across Mojave test facilities.
objectives: Recover prototype armor at Yucca Mountain
Secure Tesla Cannon at Nevada Test Site
Investigate experimental serum at Helios One

endings.consequence: The Mojave is spared from nuclear escalation.

endings.description: You sell them to a faction.
You keep the prototypes for yourself.
endings.consequence: You become a feared figure in the Mojave.

name: Shadows of the Strip
description: Uncover corruption and secrets hidden within the Strip casinos.

endings.consequence: You gain power in the underworld.

name: NCR Final Push
description: Lead NCR forces in a decisive assault against Legion strongholds.
objectives: Rally demoralized troops at Forlorn Hope
Secure the dam in the final battle

name: Brotherhood Purge
description: Aid or oppose the Brotherhood of Steel in their tech reclamation crusade.

name: Khan Alliance
description: Forge the Great Khans into a new power or crush them.
objectives: Meet Papa Khan at Red Rock

name: Volare! Reborn
description: Help the Boomers achieve flight once more.
objectives: Raise the B-29 from Lake Mead

name: Followers' Aid
description: Expand the Followers of the Apocalypse's humanitarian reach.

name: Legion Revolt
description: Incite or crush a slave uprising in Caesar's Legion.

name: Powder Uprising
description: Lead the Powder Gangers to power or destruction.

name: White Glove Feast
description: Uncover the White Glove Society's darkest secrets.

name: Kings' Gambit
description: Broker peace or war between the Kings and NCR in Freeside.
objectives: Meet the King in his school

name: Remnants' Power
description: Awaken Enclave remnants for one final mission.

name: Nipton Ashes
description: Avenge or exploit the horrors of Nipton's lottery.

name: Black Mountain
description: Resolve the super mutant/nightkin conflict at Black Mountain.

name: Ghost Town Gunfight
description: Help Goodsprings defend against Powder Gangers.

name: Three-Card Bounty
description: Hunt escaped convicts.

name: Buried Treasure
description: Follow clues to hidden cache.

name: Caravan Rescue
description: Save caravan from mutants.

name: Lost Prospector
description: Find missing miner.

name: Radio Repair
description: Fix settler's radio.

name: Fiend Heads
description: Collect fiend bounties.

name: Nightkin Hunt
description: Deal with stealthy nightkin.

name: Aba Daba Honeymoon
description: Run chems for Khans.

name: Bleed Me Dry
description: Collect creature eggs.

name: ED-E My Love
description: Upgrade broken eyebot.

name: G.I. Blues
description: Solve Kings' troubles.

name: Heartache by the Number
description: Help Cass avenge her caravan.

name: Crazy, Crazy, Crazy
description: Free Neil from Tabitha.

name: Come Fly With Me
description: Launch ghouls into space.

name: Beyond the Beef
description: Solve missing person case.

name: High Times
description: Cure addicts.

name: I Could Make You Care
description: Help Veronica question BoS.

name: I Forgot to Remember to Forget
description: Help Boone find peace.

name: I Put a Spell on You
description: Find NCR spy.

name: My Kind of Town
description: Install new sheriff.
objectives: Choose NCR, robot, or outlaw leader

name: Sunset Sarsaparilla Star
description: Collect 50 star caps.

name: Boulder City Blues
description: Resolve Khan hostage situation.

name: Wheel of Fortune
description: Help stranded travelers.

name: The Fizz Awakens
description: Investigate the sudden reactivation of pre-war FizzCo systems beneath the Strip.
objectives: Enter Vault 77 through the collapsed Strip tunnels
Access the hidden subsystem beneath Lucky 38

endings.consequence: Atomic Fizz Caps become the dominant wasteland currency.

endings.description: You shut down the subsystem permanently.
endings.consequence: FizzCo tech goes dark, factions panic.

endings.description: You corrupt the CapChain for personal gain.
endings.consequence: You secretly control the wasteland’s economy.

name: The Platinum Cap
description: Assemble the legendary Platinum Cap, an upgrade key capable of rewriting the wasteland economy.
objectives: Recover the empty Platinum Cap Shell
Install the Robot Relic Instruction Chip
Forge the completed Platinum Cap in the Executive Vault

endings.consequence: Your caps gain increased value across all vendors.

endings.description: You sell the Platinum Cap to a faction.

name: Formula of 77
description: Recreate the original Atomic Fizz formula using scattered pre-war research.
objectives: Recover a sample of Atomic Fizz
Stabilize the mixture using Helios One’s solar arrays

endings.description: You perfect the Atomic Fizz formula.
endings.consequence: You become the Mojave’s most valuable chemist.
Side effects spread through the Mojave.

name: The Robot That Remembered
description: Help a damaged FizzCo courier robot recover its lost memory routines.

name: Under-Strip Tunnels
description: Explore the forgotten tunnels beneath the Strip and uncover FizzCo’s hidden infrastructure.

name: Old-World Conversion
description: Convert old-world currency into Atomic Fizz Caps using a pre-war conversion module.

name: Glow in the Dark
description: Investigate glowing creatures mutated by leaked Atomic Fizz prototypes.

name: The Lost FizzCo Shipment
description: Recover a lost pre-war FizzCo shipment buried under highway rubble.

name: Surface Protocol
description: Emerge from Vault 33 into a shattered world. Follow the CAPS Protocol signal to uncover HavenTech's conspiracy — and choose the future of the FIZZ token.
objectives: Exit Vault 33 and establish GPS bearing
Investigate Shady Sands Ruins for HavenTech evidence
Decide the fate of the CAPS Protocol

endings.description: You share the CAPS data with Moldaver's fusion collective.
endings.consequence: Free energy spreads across settlements. HavenTech collapses.

endings.description: You hand the CAPS data to the Brotherhood of Steel.
endings.consequence: Brotherhood controls CAPS infrastructure. Order enforced at gunpoint.

endings.description: You keep the CAPS data and build your own FIZZ network.
endings.consequence: You become the new architect of the CAPS Protocol.

name: The Last Bounty
description: Cooper Howard — The Ghoul — has been hunting a FizzCo whistleblower for two centuries. Follow his trail across the Western wasteland and uncover the truth about the CAPS origin.
objectives: Find Cooper Howard at his ranch ruins
Track Dr. Elara Voss across three wasteland locations
Discover the whistleblower's truth about CAPS
Make the final call: Cooper's target or the truth?

endings.description: Help Cooper find his daughter's vault.
endings.consequence: Cooper finds peace. His daughter's vault data unlocks new FIZZ rewards.

endings.description: Protect Dr. Voss. She releases CAPS data publicly.
endings.consequence: The truth about HavenTech spreads across all radio frequencies.

endings.description: Complete the HavenTech bounty. Dr. Voss is silenced.
endings.consequence: HavenTech rewards you. Every other faction loses trust.

name: The Boneyard Rises
description: In 2161 Southern California, the Master's Army marches and the Hub's merchant network teeters on collapse. A pre-war CAPS relay node — the first — was buried beneath the Boneyard. Find it before the Children of the Cathedral do.
objectives: Speak with Hub merchants about the old CAPS relay
Recover the Vault-Tec CAPS Node Alpha
Decide whether to activate or destroy the node

endings.description: You activate CAPS Node Alpha — the Hub's trade network explodes in value.
endings.consequence: The first above-ground CAPS network goes live in 2161.

endings.description: You destroy the node to keep it from the Master.
endings.consequence: The Master loses a key resource. The wasteland is safer, for now.

endings.description: You sell the node data to a Vault City precursor faction.
endings.consequence: The data accelerates technological recovery but concentrates power.

name: The Chosen One's Legacy
description: The Shi of San Francisco have decoded an old Vault-Tec transmission describing the CAPS Protocol. The Enclave wants it. The NCR wants it. The New Reno crime families will sell it to anyone. Get there first.
objectives: Travel to San Francisco and meet the Shi
Navigate NCR politics and New Reno crime families
Secure the CAPS data before the Enclave arrives

endings.description: Give the transmission to the NCR. They standardize caps across California.
endings.consequence: The NCR's currency becomes the most trusted in the wasteland.

endings.description: Let the Shi keep the data. They build a CAPS relay network at sea.
endings.consequence: A secret Pacific CAPS network emerges, unknown to factions.

endings.description: Sell it to New Reno. Crime families control the CAPS market.
endings.consequence: CAPS become corrupted by organized crime. Inflation follows.

name: The Purity War
description: The Enclave is using Project Purity's water purification system to access hidden CAPS Protocol nodes embedded in the Capital Wasteland's water infrastructure. Stop them — or join them — before the clean water and the CAPS network become weapons.
objectives: Investigate the Enclave's CAPS node extraction at Jefferson Memorial
Secure GNR Building as CAPS broadcast relay
Defend Project Purity from Enclave forces
Upload or destroy the CAPS Protocol data

endings.description: Activate Project Purity AND the CAPS node. Clean water and clean currency flow together.
endings.consequence: The Capital Wasteland prospers. The CAPS network grows.

endings.description: Let the Enclave control the CAPS node. They rebuild federal currency.
endings.consequence: Enclave gains economic power. Other factions scramble to adapt.

endings.description: Destroy both Project Purity and the CAPS node to deny the Enclave.
endings.consequence: The Capital Wasteland loses clean water but gains freedom from corporate control.

name: Synth Revelation
description: The Institute has been embedding CAPS Protocol tracking nodes in synth neural networks — every synth is a walking CAPS terminal. The Railroad wants to free the synths. The Brotherhood wants to destroy them. You want the CAPS data they carry.
objectives: Investigate CAPS node anomalies in Diamond City
Choose: Railroad liberation, Brotherhood purge, or independent extraction
Extract or broadcast the synth-carried CAPS data

endings.description: Free the synths. They carry CAPS data to freedom — and share it openly.
endings.consequence: Synths are free. CAPS data democratized. Institute weakened.

endings.description: Purge the Institute with the Brotherhood. CAPS data salvaged from wreckage.
endings.consequence: Institute destroyed. Brotherhood controls recovered CAPS archives.

endings.description: Use Minutemen to neutralize the Institute peacefully. CAPS data distributed to settlements.
endings.consequence: Commonwealth settles rebuild with CAPS infrastructure. Hope spreads.

name: First Light
description: Reclamation Day. Vault 76 opens. Among the standard survival gear, your Pip-Boy is receiving a strange signal — fragmented CAPS Protocol data from Vault 77. Someone is trying to warn you about what you'll find on the surface. And what finds you first.
objectives: Exit Vault 76 and triangulate the CAPS signal
Investigate Flatwoods for Responder CAPS terminal
Secure the Whitespring's Vault-Tec archive room
Decode the Vault 77 transmission at Morgantown Airport
Send a reply to Vault 77 Overseer AI

endings.description: Broadcast the Vault 77 signal across Appalachia. All dwellers receive CAPS data.
endings.consequence: Appalachian survivors gain early CAPS network access. FizzCo protocol begins.

endings.description: Secure the signal for yourself. You control the CAPS bootstrap node.
endings.consequence: You hold the first key to the FIZZ token network. Power and responsibility.

endings.description: Destroy the transmitter. The CAPS signal dies in Appalachia.
endings.consequence: Appalachia develops independently. The FIZZ network is delayed by decades.
